content:
In The Bleak Midwinter
CAPO 3rd fret (or whichever fits your voice)


[Intro]
[ch]C[/ch]    [ch]Am[/ch]    [ch]Dm[/ch]  [ch]G[/ch]  [ch]C[/ch]


[Verse 1]
[tab][ch]C[/ch]               [ch]Am[/ch]      [ch]Dm[/ch]               [ch]G[/ch]
In the bleak midwinter, frosty wind made moan,[/tab]
[tab][ch]C[/ch]                   [ch]Am[/ch]    [ch]Dm[/ch]    [ch]G[/ch]       [ch]C[/ch]
Earth stood hard as iron, water like a stone;[/tab]
[tab][ch]Dm[/ch]                [ch]Am[/ch]            [ch]C[/ch]       [ch]Dm[/ch]      [ch]G[/ch]
Snow had fallen, snow on snow, snow on snow on snow,[/tab]
[tab][ch]C[/ch]               [ch]Am[/ch]      [ch]Dm[/ch] [ch]G[/ch]  [ch]C[/ch]
In the bleak midwinter, long ago.[/tab]


[Verse 2]
[tab][ch]C[/ch]                       [ch]Am[/ch]        [ch]Dm[/ch]          [ch]G[/ch]
Our God, Heaven cannot hold him, nor earth sustain;[/tab]
[tab][ch]C[/ch]                       [ch]Am[/ch]        [ch]Dm[/ch]      [ch]G[/ch]        [ch]C[/ch]
Heaven and earth shall flee away when he comes to reign.[/tab]
[tab][ch]Dm[/ch]              [ch]Am[/ch]        [ch]C[/ch]      [ch]Dm[/ch]       [ch]G[/ch]
In the bleak midwinter a stable place sufficed[/tab]
[tab]     [ch]C[/ch]          [ch]Am[/ch]     [ch]Dm[/ch] [ch]G[/ch]   [ch]C[/ch]
The Lord God almighty, Jesus Christ.[/tab]


[Verse 3]
[tab][ch]C[/ch]              [ch]Am[/ch]     [ch]D7[/ch]                [ch]G[/ch]
Angels and Archangels may have gathered there,[/tab]
[tab][ch]C[/ch]            [ch]Am[/ch]       [ch]Dm[/ch]   [ch]G[/ch]       [ch]C[/ch]
Cherubim and seraphim thronged the air;[/tab]
[tab][ch]Dm[/ch]             [ch]Am[/ch]    [ch]C[/ch]      [ch]Dm[/ch]     [ch]G[/ch]
But his mother only, in her maiden bliss,[/tab]
[tab][ch]C[/ch]               [ch]Am[/ch]    [ch]Dm[/ch]   [ch]G[/ch] [ch]C[/ch]
Worshiped the beloved with a kiss.[/tab]


[Verse 4]
[tab][ch]C[/ch]          [ch]Am[/ch]        [ch]Dm[/ch]        [ch]G[/ch]
What can I give him, poor as I am?[/tab]
[tab][ch]C[/ch]           [ch]Am[/ch]        [ch]Dm[/ch]       [ch]G[/ch]      [ch]C[/ch]
If I were a shepherd, I would bring a lamb;[/tab]
[tab][ch]Dm[/ch]           [ch]Am[/ch]       [ch]C[/ch]       [ch]Dm[/ch]    [ch]G[/ch]
If I were a wise man, I would do my part;[/tab]
[tab][ch]C[/ch]                [ch]Am[/ch]        [ch]Dm[/ch]   [ch]G[/ch]  [ch]C[/ch]
Yet what I can I give him: give my heart.[/tab]


This is my representation of the following version sung by Matt Doyle & Alice Lee:
http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6WInpzTitHE
